Cross-asset sensitivity

Each estimate describes the change in an asset associated with a 10 basis point increase in the selected rate instrument during the same announcement window. Positive values indicate that the asset measure rose.

Loading release-window estimates…

Which yields moved when the curve flattened or steepened?

A flatter curve can accompany a sell-off at both maturities, a rally at both, or a rise in the two-year yield alongside a fall in the ten-year. Each has a different consequence for an outright bond position.

The Fed sample uses US Treasuries around scheduled meetings. The ECB sample uses German government yields in standard meeting windows. Both yields are observed in the same intraday window. The slope change is the ten-year change less the two-year change. Policy expectations, term premia and other news can all affect these yields. Market pricing for a particular policy meeting requires a separate instrument.

When the decision was priced in

Fed projections and next-meeting pricing

Scheduled FOMC announcements from 2019. MP1 measures the current decision surprise and MP2 the change in pricing for the next meeting, from ten minutes before the statement to twenty minutes after. Participants’ projections accompany the statement on SEP dates. Both reach markets together, so these comparisons cannot isolate the effect of the projections. The later press conference has its own window.

San Francisco Fed event data and definitions
15 December 2022 · The expected hike and the next three meetings

The ECB’s subsequent meeting account records the path investors expected going in. It envisaged 50 bp in December, a further 50 bp in February and a final 25 bp in March, taking the peak to about 2.8%. The December increase was 50 bp. Those rounded figures come from the meeting briefing.

In the Q&A, Christine Lagarde said incoming data then pointed to a succession of half-point increases. One-year euro OIS rose 3.46 bp in the release window and a further 11.51 bp in the conference window. German two-year yields rose 9.20 bp and 16.95 bp respectively. The German 2s10s spread narrowed by 1.00 bp and then by 8.90 bp.

US retail sales came out at 14:30 Frankfurt time, during the quote interval shared by the two windows. The recorded moves can reflect both releases.

Headline direction and repricing

Each outlet contributes one reading per meeting. The groups reflect the policy direction expressed in the coverage. A title can report a cut or hike while giving no direction for the next move.

Reuters decision coverage at every scheduled 2025 FOMC meeting

2025 is the last complete calendar year in the study. The sample takes one Reuters straight-news decision report per meeting, including those whose headlines give no clear indication of the next move. The linked article can be an updated edition of a story first filed before the decision.
